notes: Rev. Proc. 2025-19 sec. 3.01 (2026 limits). 2025 figures are from Rev. Proc. 2024-25. The age-55 catch-up is fixed by statute (IRC 223(b)(3)) and not indexed. HSA contributions require HDHP coverage and no general-purpose health FSA; a limited-purpose (dental/vision) FSA is compatible. FSAs are not modeled as accounts: they are use-it-or-lose-it spending allowances, not investable.
